description: v2.2.10 (pre-release re-cut #5; replaces the earlier v2.2.10 assets). Universal patches: removed Clone app, Force not debuggable and Lock down exported components; hid Spoof app signature and Spoof install source as internal dependencies; merged the three WebView patches into WebView hardening (adds autoplay, geolocation, third-party cookie and popup switches); added Block advertising & device IDs, Block in-app update & review prompts, Block crash-reporting SDKs, Force offline mode and Block Play Billing purchase prompts. Gboard 18.5.4 adds an ARM target, offline-only voice routing, stricter privacy defaults, telemetry/backup hardening and an optional Bluetooth voice-routing disable patch. Proton Pass 1.41.3 adds F-Droid support plus screenshots, clipboard auto-clear, app-lock and telemetry patches. Verified by building the Android bundle, applying the new patches to the F-Droid Proton Pass APK and armeabi-v7a Gboard APK, running the permission and Brave test tasks, and regenerating patches-list.json/README; no on-device runtime verification yet. 145 patch entries / 187 appearances / 32 apps.
